title: The algebraic sphere-generator identity
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The algebraic sphere-generator identity. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Fix a unit vector \(w\in\mathbb R^I\), a real function \(f\), an ambient vector \(u\), and \(\lambda\ge0\). Interpret \(Df\) and \(D^2f\) as the total Fréchet-derivative operators used in Lean. With projected columns \(p_j=e_j-w_jw\), the displayed algebraic equality holds. For a C² ambient test near the unit sphere, it is the usual identity for the Itô generator with noise columns \(\sqrt{2\lambda}\,p_j\) and radial drift \(-\lambda(d-1)w\), where \(d=|I|\).
